title: State art museum; establishment.
bodyHtml:
§9-22  State art museum; establishment.  The state art museum is established within the foundation.  The operations of the state art museum shall be funded and supported by:

     (1)  Appropriations from the legislature;

     (2)  Federal grants and subsidies;

     (3)  Voluntary contributions; and

     (4)  Funds received pursuant to section 9-3(7). [L 2004, c 125, pt of §2; am L 2025, c 131, §5]
